overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies Ashok Chaal Powder in bulk for B2B buyers. We are an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter based in India. Our powder is dehydrated and processed to a fine 80-100 mesh size, with moisture below 10%. It is suitable for manufacturers, brands, and distributors looking for a consistent raw ingredient.

We follow a 6-step process: sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. We offer OEM and private label support, custom mesh and packaging on request, and export documentation support. Samples are available on request, with a minimum order quantity of 5 Kg. Shelf life is 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture.
